recentItems.title: SANTHASEELA BABU Forest Officer (Retd) About Red Sandalwood Smuggling in Goods Train Incident
recentItems.description:
#SanthaSeelaBabu, #RedSandalwoodSmugglers, #ForestOfficer, #WildlifeCrime, #APForestDepartment, #TrueStory, #CrimeInvestigation, #VanaSouryaAward,
 SANTHASEELA BABU Forest Officer (Retd) About Red Sandalwood Smuggling in Goods Train Incident 


Modus Operandi of Smugglers: Smugglers masterminded a unique tactic of hiding red sandalwood logs underneath heavy layers of iron ore inside running goods trains heading toward Madras.

Train Interception Plan: The gang coordinated with insiders to halt the goods train briefly at isolated spots (near Chintarajupalle in Cuddapah) to rapidly load timber within minutes.

The Violent Ambush: When the flying squad intercepted the operation, a large mob of villagers and smugglers attacked the team with stones, injuring staff members.

Retaliation & Self-Defense: Facing severe life-threatening danger and seeing his colleague bleeding, the officer was forced to open fire in self-defense to protect government property and personnel.

The Aftermath & Arrests: Following the incident, a massive follow-up search operation led by police and forest officials successfully recovered over one ton of red sandalwood from the village, resulting in the conviction of 23 individuals.

Vana Sourya Award Recognition: For risking his life and courageously safeguarding state property against violent timber mafias, retired DFO V. Santha Seela Babu was honored with United Andhra Pradesh's very first "Vana Sourya" gallantry award.
